title: Best ever chocolate brownies recipe
steps: Cut 185g unsalted butter into small cubes and tip into a medium bowl
Fill a small saucepan about a quarter full with hot water, then sit the bowl on top so it rests on the rim of the pan, not touching the water
Remove the bowl from the pan
While you wait for the chocolate to cool, position a shelf in the middle of your oven and turn the oven on to 180C/160C fan/gas 4.
Using a shallow 20cm square tin, cut out a square of kitchen foil (or non-stick baking parchment) to line the base
Chop 50g white chocolate and 50g milk chocolate into chunks on a board.
